SEWAGE.gloss: waste matter carried away in sewers or drains
SEWAGE.definition: Waste matter carried away in sewers or drains.

WAGES.gloss: a recompense for worthy acts or retribution for wrongdoing
WAGES.definition: A recompense for worthy acts or retribution for wrongdoing.
WAGES.example: The wages of sin is death.

EASE.example: He eased himself into the chair.

SAGE.gloss: a mentor in spiritual and philosophical topics who is renowned for profound wisdom
SAGE.definition: A mentor in spiritual and philosophical topics who is renowned for profound wisdom.

SEE.gloss: perceive by sight or have the power to perceive by sight
SEE.definition: Perceive by sight or have the power to perceive by sight.
SEE.example: You have to be a good observer to see all the details.

AGE.example: It was replaced because of its age.

SEA.gloss: a division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land
SEA.definition: A division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land.

GAS.gloss: the state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid states by
GAS.definition: The state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid states by: relatively low density and viscosity; relatively great expansion and contraction with changes in pressure and temperature; the ability to diffuse readily; and the spontaneous tendency to become distributed uniformly throughout any container.

AWE.gloss: an overwhelming feeling of wonder or admiration
AWE.definition: An overwhelming feeling of wonder or admiration.
AWE.example: He stared over the edge with a feeling of awe.

GEE.gloss: a unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity
GEE.definition: A unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity; used to indicate the force to which a body is subjected when it is accelerated.
